svg.title: Connections that have a reason
svg.desc: D07.1 · Directed route specification · New hardware and control rules are proposals; recipe quantities remain unfrozen.
svg.text: D07.1 · Directed route specification · New hardware and control rules are proposals; recipe quantities remain unfrozen.
Dashed card = provisional recipe or equipment
01 FOOD · a destination owns every release
Staff lifts stock onto timber table
Reference fish path is observed; the port geometry, buffers and reservation logic are new design.
Independent IN and OUT trays; no belt through the central storage aisle.
There is no automatic OUT → IN return route.
* A56.5–59s supports the dual-feeder topology and a direct service output.
Ingredient eligibility, exact product identity, ratios, fuel and timing are not frozen.
Cycle start: reserve both accepted ingredients and output space together; otherwise WAIT.
02 UTILITY · typed local storage, no food or fuel on this lane
No ore → ingot claim. No workshop parts, greenhouse yields or new recipe quantities are inferred.
A disabled future socket is a reserved interface, not an operating production line.
Warmth / upgrade state, not a processed item
Not a smelter; receives no food conveyor
MANUAL / NOT YET ELIGIBLE FOR BELTS
Raw-food storage / raw sales: manual + explicit catalogue
Hides / fur · cargo / cash · butcher tables · drying racks
Cookfire / cookhouse · chopping fixtures · crates / sled handoffs
Workshop / greenhouse outputs unspecified; no active recipe route.
FULL / WRONG ITEM: hold → stop upstream release. No deletion, duplication, mixed universal loop or unbounded queue.
